feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass-fed means that none of our beef critters receive any type of processed grain.

resold_note: Also sells turkeys from Back Acres Farm, chicken and raw milk from Grace Pond Farm, and cheese, yogurt, butter, ice cream and other goods from other Maine producers.
notes: Checked homepage, our meat, farm store, FAQ, whole beef deposit page and the grass-fed beef post. FAQ quote confirmed; beef is 100% grass-fed on pasture and farm hay and haylage, pork and chicken get a non-GMO grain ration. Beef arrives as yearling calves and piglets come from another Maine farm; both are raised here. Chicken flock is a couple hundred birds, topped up by Grace Pond Farm. Farm store open Wednesday to Saturday; does not ship; whole and side beef picked up on the farm, generally November to March.
